verdict.rationale: Expensify documents real-time SmartScan capture of merchant, date, total and currency from receipts, imported card feeds, multi-level GL coding, and AI- or rule-driven categorizing and tagging, with automatic export to QuickBooks Online and NetSuite. That covers most of capturing and coding spend as it happens. A hands-on community report says categorization is wrong about 70% of the time unless the purchase is obvious, and another describes slow receipt processing; both are dated, but they leave the reliability of automatic coding unproven. missing for 10: documented memo capture at time of spend, evidence that categories are applied automatically and accurately at capture (not just on request via AI or rules), and recent independent corroboration that coding is accurate enough to make close a review step.
